rule.statement: A trust is imposed by law on those who try to camouflage the actual nature of a transaction, and when attendant circumstances point to a loan transaction, not a genuine sale transaction, the provisions of the Trust Ordinance apply.
rule.supporting_quote: The trust is an obligation imposed by law on those who try to camouflage the actual nature of the transaction. When the attendant circumstances point to a loan transaction and not a genuine sale transaction the provisions of section 83 of the Trust Ordinance apply.
